content: Dumma Dumma Wogata
GODAY Muse hizgides,
«Hayssa Isra7eele naytas yoota, ‹Tani GODAY intte Xoossay dumma gidida mala intteka dumma gidite.
« ‹Inttefe oonikka attontta ba aawaanne ba aayo bonchcho; ta inttena azazida mala Sambata gallassata bonchcho; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹Tana aggidi eeqatas goynnofte; woykko eeqa Xoossata biratappe seerisidi inttes medhdhofte; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹Intte issifeteththa yarsho GODAAS shiishshiza wode he yarshoy intte gishshas ekettana bessiza mala yarshite.
Yarshoza shiishshida gallas woykko wonteththa gallas meetettanaas bessees; heedzdzanththo gallas gakkanaas gam7ida yarshoy wurikka taman xuugetto.
Heedzdzanththo gallassan iza miikko hessi tuna; hessa gishshas tani he yarshoza ekkike.
Izappe midaadey oonikka taas dummatidayssa hada miishsha mala qoodida gishshas izi ba nagaran oyshettana; hessaadey ba dere asaa giddofe shaaketti dhayo.
« ‹Intte maxa wode intte kath maxishin gaxa bolla diza kath maxopite; intte maxishin geedon attida puushechcho maxanaas guye simmofte.

Neni ne woyne miththa ayfe maxishin hagga giddon qotetti attidayssa woykko gaden qoqofettidayssa qora ekkanaas guye simmofa; heytantta ubbaa manqotassinne bete yidaytas aggaaga; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹Kaysotopite; as baleththofte; wordo haasayopite;
« ‹Ta sunththan wordora caaqqofte; wordo caaqqidi intte Xoossa sunththaa tunisopite; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹As baleththofa; woykko asa miishshe bonqqa ekkofa; miishshe immana gaada ne ooso oosisidaades miishshaa immontta dashe ne achchan issi qammaka ayssofa.
« ‹Siyenna gaada tulle cayoppa; qooqey dhuphettidi kundana mala iza sinththan dhuphizaaz woththofa; ne Xoossas yayya; tani GODAA ne Xoossa.
« ‹Neni pirda pirdiza wode pirda geellasoppa; manqo iza manqoteththa gishshas maadda pirdofa; gita asatas dumma bonchcho immofa; dere asaakka dumma maadda pirdofa; asa ubbaas tumu pirda pirda.
« ‹Neni asa giddon zigirs ekkada yuuyoppa; ne shooroza hayqos gaththiza ay miishshika ooththofa; tani ne GODAA.
« ‹Ne isha ne wozinan ixxofa; iza gaason nees nagara gidontta mala ne shooroza hanqa.
« ‹As ubbaa ne nena siiqiza mala siiqa attiin ay asa bollaka ne ulon lancce oykkada halo kessofa; tani GODAA.
« ‹Ta azazota naagite; dumma dumma qommo meheta issi bolla gaththi mehetisofte; nam7u qommo kaththa zereth walakkidi issi bolla zeropite; nam7u qommo miishshafe dadettida may7o may7ofte.
« ‹Issaadey hara asara giigetta uttida aylleyra laymatikko izakka ba aylleteththafe wozzettonttaaro gidikko izaadey qaxxayetto; gidikkoka iza wozzettontta gishshas nam7ayka hayqqofetto.
Hessa mala qoho gaththidaadey qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarshos issi dharsho gaytoteththa dunkaane penge GODAA sinth eho.
Qeesezikka hessaade nagara wursanaas Xoossa sinththan qoho yarshos imettida dharshoza shiishsho; izaade nagaraykka atto geetettana.

« ‹Intte Kanaane gelidi ayfe ayfiza mith tokkiko he ayfe ayfiza miththaya ayfe doommoosofe biidi heedzdzu layth gakkanaas immiza ayfey meetettontta digettidayssa erite; he layththatan he miththata ayfe moopite.
Oydanththo layththa bolla he miththaa ayfey ubbay GODAAS galatas shiishshiza yarsho gido.

Ichchashanththo layththan qasse miththaa ayfeza inttes miite; intte hessaththo histtiko ayfe ayfiza intte miththay woden woden inttes immiza ayfey kaseppe gede gujetti gujetti baana; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹Suuththara diza ay ashokka moopite; maroththoftenne bita bitopite.
« ‹Intte hu7e binana garsara yuushshi aaththidi qanxxofte; intte buuchchaaka qaanththan qanxxofte.
« ‹Intte asateththa bolla niqse cach caddofte; woykko asi hayqqiko izas mishettidi intte bolla qanxxi madunththofte; tani GODAA.
« ‹Biittaya laymaninne tunateththan kumontta mala ne nayo laymateththa oosos aaththa immada kawushshofa.
Ta Sambata gallassata naagite; ta keeththaa bonchchite; tani GODAA.
« ‹Moytille haasayssizayta woykko iita ayanata haasayssizayta zore oychchofa; intte tunontta mala istta koyopite; tani GODAY intte Xoossa.
« ‹Neeppe cimmidaade beykko ne uttidasohoppe denda eqqada bonchcha; taas Xoossas yashshateththan azazetta; tani GODAA.
« ‹Hara biittafe yiidi intte giddon diza asata qohopite.
Intte intte dere asas ooththiza mala isttaskka lo7o ooththite; intte inttena siiqiza mala isttaka siiqite; kase intteka Gibxe biittan beteta gididayssa yuushshi qopite; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
« ‹Maka miishshen gidiin woykko meezaanen woykko wadha miishshan as cimmofte.
As cimmontta tumu meezaaney, maka miishshinne mixe miishshi inttes de7o; tani inttena Gibxeppe kessida GODAA intte Xoossa.
« ‹Ta inttes immida ta azazotanne ta wogata ubbaa naagitenne ooththite; tani intte GODAA.› »
